category: General Announcement for PLC
title: MATERIAL LITIGATION
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM")
COMPLAINT FILED BY RAV BAHAMAS LTD AGAINST GENTING AMERICAS INC, AN INDIRECT WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD
(The definitions used in this announcement shall have the same meanings as that used in our announcements dated 14 October 2024 and 17 October 2024 (“
Initial Announcements
”) unless stated otherwise.
All capitalised terms used herein shall, unless otherwise defined, have the same meanings as ascribed thereto in the Initial Announcements.)
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to inform that on 22 November 2024 (United States Eastern date/time), Genting Americas Inc. (“GAI”) filed a motion to dismiss the Complaint filed by RAV Bahamas Ltd. in the United States District Court, Southern District of Florida (“US Court”). GAI seeks dismissal of the Complaint on multiple grounds, including that this is a shareholder dispute and therefore should be dealt with pursuant to the Shareholders’ Agreement between the shareholders of BB Entertainment Ltd in a forum other than the US Court; the claims are time-barred; and the Complaint fails to adequately allege facts showing that the required elements for each claim have been met. GAI continues to firmly believe that the Complaint is baseless and without merit, and will continue to defend against these claims.
GENM will make further announcements as and when there are material developments on the above matter.
This announcement is dated 25 November 2024.

Working experience and occupation
Ms Loh Wai Yee is appointed as the Chief Financial Officer of Genting Malaysia Berhad with effect from 1 April 2025. She is responsible for the Finance, Risk Management, Procurement and Regulatory Compliance functions of the Company. She joined the Company in June 2023 as the Senior Vice President - Finance and was redesignated as the Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Resorts World Genting) on 1 August 2023.  She has over 30 years of work experience in finance, strategy, investments management, risk management and audit.
Prior to joining the Company, she held senior leadership positions with Tenaga Nasional Berhad, Destination Resort and Hotel Sdn Bhd, and Penerbangan Malaysia Berhad. She also spent several years in the Investment Division of Khazanah Nasional Berhad, the sovereign wealth fund of Malaysia.
Prior to joining the commercial sector, she trained as a chartered accountant in a public accounting firm in London before returning to PricewaterhouseCoopers, Kuala Lumpur as an audit senior and rose to rank of senior manager.

body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY")
SUBMISSION OF THE DOWNSTATE NEW YORK COMMERCIAL CASINO LICENSE BID
In January 2023, the New York Gaming Facility Board (“NYGFB”) had issued a Request for Application (“RFA”) to solicit proposals for up to three commercial casinos in downstate New York, where Resorts World New York City (“RWNYC”) is located.
The GENM Board of Directors wishes to announce that GENM, via its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Genting New York LLC (“GENNY”) had submitted a bid for a commercial casino license (“Bid”) to the New York State Gaming Commission on 27 June 2025 (US Eastern date/time) in response to the RFA.
GENNY owns and operates RWNYC, a gaming destination at the historic Aqueduct Racetrack, currently offering approximately 5,500 slot machines and electronic table games, restaurants and bars, event spaces and a 400-room Hyatt hotel. Having operated in the New York State for nearly 15 years since October 2011, RWNYC is uniquely positioned to transform itself into a world-class integrated resort destination with a proposed multi-billion-dollar investment in conjunction with its Bid. This will drive RWNYC’s next chapter of growth, enabling it to further expand its customer base and market reach.
The NYGFB is expected to make a decision by 1 December 2025, followed by the issuance of licenses by 31 December 2025. GENM will make appropriate announcements once there are further material developments in relation to its Bid.
For more information, please refer to RWNYC’s press release attached to this announcement.
This announcement is dated 30 June 2025.

title: OTHERS
body:
Request For Suspension
The Company wishes to announce that Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad (“Bursa Securities”) has approved the Company’s request for suspension in the trading of the ordinary shares of the Company with effect from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 13 October 2025, pending the release of a material announcement.
The request for suspension is made under subparagraph 3.1(b) of Practice Note 2 on Requests for Suspension of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Securities.
This announcement is dated 13 October 2025.

title: TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (PARAGRAPH/RULE 9.19 (47A))
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD
RECEIPT OF NOTICE OF CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY TAKE-OVER OFFER FROM AMINVESTMENT BANK BERHAD ON BEHALF OF GENTING BERHAD ("OFFEROR")
The Board of Directors of Genting Malaysia Berhad (“Board”) wishes to announce that the Board has on 13 October 2025 received a notice of conditional voluntary take-over offer (“Notice”) from AmInvestment Bank Berhad on behalf of the Offeror to acquire all the remaining ordinary shares in Genting Malaysia Berhad (excluding treasury shares) not already held by the Offeror (“Offer Shares”) for a cash offer price of RM2.35 per Offer Share.
A copy of the Notice is enclosed herewith and the same will be posted to the holders of the Offer Shares within 7 days from the date of this announcement.
This announcement is dated 13 October 2025.
Please refer attachment below.

title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY")
SUBMISSION OF THE DOWNSTATE NEW YORK COMMERCIAL CASINO LICENSE BID ("Bid")
The Board of Directors of GENM (“Board”) refers to GENM’s announcement dated 30 June 2025 in relation to the Bid.
The Board wishes to announce that GENM, via its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Genting New York LLC (“GENNY”) had submitted supplemental application materials to the New York Gaming Facility Location Board (“NYGFB”) on 14 October 2025 (US Eastern date/time) for its final evaluation and consideration, in response to the Response For Application (“RFA”) requirements.
As previously stated, the NYGFB is expected to announce the winning bidders by 1 December 2025, followed by the issuance of licenses by 31 December 2025. GENM will make appropriate announcements once there are further material developments in relation to its Bid.
For further information on the supplemental return materials, please refer to the NYGFB’s website at https://nycasinos.ny.gov/.
This announcement is dated 15 October 2025.

Reference is made to the GENM's announcements dated 13 October 2025, 15 October 2025, 16 October 2025, 21 October 2025, 27 October 2025 and 3 November 2025 in relation to the Offer (“Previous Announcements”). Unless otherwise stated, all abbreviations and definitions used herein shall have the same meaning as those used in GENM's Previous Announcements.
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that GENM has on 3 November 2025 received a press notice from AmInvestment Bank Berhad on behalf of the Offeror, informing that as at 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on 3 November 2025, the Offeror holds in aggregate more than 50.00% of the total issued GENM shares (excluding treasury shares).
Accordingly, the Acceptance Condition has been fulfilled and the Offer has become unconditional on 3 November 2025 ("Unconditional Date").
Unless the Offer is extended or revised, the Offer shall remain open for acceptances until 5:00 p.m. on 24 November 2025, being the First Closing Date, which is at least 14 days from the Unconditional Date.
Save for the abovementioned, all other details, terms and conditions of the Offer as set out in the Offer Document remain unchanged.

category: General Announcement for PLC
title: TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (PARAGRAPH/RULE 9.19 (47A))
body:
UNCONDITIONAL TAKE-OVER OFFER BY GENTING BERHAD ("OFFEROR") THROUGH AMINVESTMENT BANK BERHAD TO ACQUIRE ALL THE REMAINING ORDINARY SHARES IN GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM") (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES) NOT ALREADY HELD BY THE OFFEROR ("OFFER SHARES") FOR A CASH OFFER PRICE OF RM2.35 PER OFFER SHARE ("OFFER")
Reference is made to the GENM's announcements dated 13 October 2025, 15 October 2025, 16 October 2025, 21 October 2025, 27 October 2025, 29 October 2025, 30 October 2025, 3 November 2025, 4 November 2025, 5 November 2025, 6 November 2025, 7 November 2025, 10 November 2025, 11 November 2025, 12 November 2025 and 13 November 2025, in relation to the Offer (“Previous Announcements”). Unless otherwise stated, all abbreviations and definitions used herein shall have the same meaning as those used in GENM's Previous Announcements.
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that GENM has on 13 November 2025 received a press notice from AmInvestment Bank Berhad on behalf of the Offeror, informing that the Offeror has on Thursday, 13 November 2025, acquired a total of 34,929,300 GENM Shares from the open market. Following the above, and excluding Valid Acceptances received, the Offeror and the PACs have collectively acquired a total of 114,469,300 GENM Shares during the Period (as defined below), representing 2.02% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares), at prices not exceeding the Offer Price of RM2.35 per Offer Share.
As at 13 May 2025, being the beginning of the 6-month period prior to and including 13 November 2025 (“Period”), the Offeror and the PACs collectively held a total of 2,802,302,634 GENM Shares, representing 49.44% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares), which is more than 33% but not more than 50% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares).
As the Offeror and the PACs have acquired (other than through Valid Acceptances received) more than 2% of GENM Shares during the Period, GENT is required under paragraph 4.01(b) of the Rules to extend a mandatory take-over offer (“MO”) to acquire all the remaining GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares) not already held by GENT.
In view of the above, the present unconditional voluntary take-over offer has become an unconditional MO on 13 November 2025 in accordance with note 14 of paragraph 4.01 of the Rules.
The Offeror and the PACs have not purchased nor agreed to purchase any GENM Shares at a price (excluding stamp duty and commission) higher than the Offer Price in the 6 months prior to the commencement of the Offer Period and during the Offer Period, up to and including 13 November 2025. As such, there is no requirement for the Offeror to revise the Offer Price upwards in accordance with subparagraph 6.03(1) of the Rules.
For the avoidance of doubt, the Offer will continue to be undertaken solely by the Offeror and is extended to the PACs.
Further to the above, on behalf of the Offeror, AmInvestment Bank, wishes to notify the Holders that the closing time and date for the acceptance of the Offer has been extended from 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 24 November 2025 to 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 1 December 2025 (“Extended Closing Date”).
Other than the Offer becoming an unconditional MO and the Extended Closing Date, all other terms and conditions of the Offer as set out in the Offer Document remain unchanged.
A notification will be dispatched to the shareholders of the Offeree in due course to notify, amongst others, the details of the matters above.
Please refer to the attached press notice dated 13 November 2025 for further information.
This announcement is dated 13 November 2025.

title: TAKE-OVERS & MERGERS (PARAGRAPH/RULE 9.19 (47A))
body:
UNCONDITIONAL MANDATORY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY GENTING BERHAD ("OFFEROR") THROUGH AMINVESTMENT BANK BERHAD TO ACQUIRE ALL THE REMAINING ORDINARY SHARES IN GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM") (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES) NOT ALREADY HELD BY THE OFFEROR ("OFFER SHARES") FOR A CASH OFFER PRICE OF RM2.35 PER OFFER SHARE ("OFFER")
Reference is made to the GENM's announcements dated 13 October 2025, 15 October 2025, 16 October 2025, 21 October 2025, 27 October 2025, 29 October 2025, 30 October 2025, 3 November 2025, 4 November 2025, 5 November 2025, 6 November 2025, 7 November 2025, 10 November 2025, 11 November 2025, 12 November 2025, 13 November 2025, 14 November 2025, 17 November 2025, 18 November 2025, 21 November 2025, 24 November 2025, 25 November 2025, 26 November 2025, 28 November 2025 and 1 December 2025 in relation to the Offer (“Previous Announcements”). Unless otherwise stated, all abbreviations and definitions used herein shall have the same meaning as those used in GENM's Previous Announcements.
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that GENM has on 1 December 2025 received a press notice from AmInvestment Bank Berhad on behalf of the Offeror, informing the Offer has closed at 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 1 December 2025 (“Final Closing Date”).
In accordance with Paragraph 13.01 of the Rules, GENT holds 4,144,966,481 GENM Shares, representing 73.13% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares) as at the Final Closing Date, by way of open market purchases and acceptances under the Offer, as set out in the attached press notice.
Please refer to the attached press notice for further information.
This announcement is dated 1 December 2025.
Please refer attachment below.

category: General Announcement for PLC
title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM")
SUBMISSION OF THE DOWNSTATE NEW YORK COMMERCIAL CASINO LICENSE BID ("BID")
The Board of Directors of GENM (“Board”) refers to GENM’s announcements dated 30 June 2025 and 15 October 2025 in relation to the Bid.
The Board wishes to announce that the Bid by Genting New York LLC, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of GENM, has been selected by the New York Gaming Facility Location Board (“NYGFB”) to proceed to licensure consideration by the New York State Gaming Commission (“NYSGC”), on 1 December 2025 (US Eastern date/time).
The NYSGC is expected to announce the issuance of licenses by 31 December 2025. GENM will make appropriate announcements once there are further material developments in relation to this matter.
For further information, please refer to the NYGFB’s website at https://nycasinos.ny.gov/.
This announcement is dated 2 December 2025.

GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM") 

REDEMPTION OF RM75,000,000.00 IN NOMINAL VALUE OF MEDIUM TERM NOTES ("MTNS") ISSUED UNDER THE MTN PROGRAMME WITH AN AGGREGATE NOMINAL VALUE OF RM5.0 BILLION BY GENM CAPITAL BERHAD ("GENM CAPITAL") AND GUARANTEED BY GENM ("MTN PROGRAMME")
We refer to the announcements dated 8 September 2014, 24 August 2015, 31 March 2017, 11 May 2021, 5 May 2023, 31 May 2024, 10 June 2024, 10 July 2024 and 5 December 2024 in relation to the MTN Programme (collectively, the “
Announcements
”). The definitions used in this announcement, unless stated otherwise, shall have the same meaning(s) as those used in the Announcements.
Pursuant to Paragraph 9.19 (38) of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, the Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that GENM Capital has today redeemed in full the nominal value of the RM75 million MTNs issued on 5 December 2024 under the MTN Programme.
This announcement is dated 5 December 2025.

title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM")
SUBMISSION OF THE DOWNSTATE NEW YORK COMMERCIAL CASINO LICENSE BID ("BID")
The Board of Directors of GENM (“Board”) refers to GENM’s announcements dated 30 June 2025, 15 October 2025 and 2 December 2025 in relation to the Bid.
The Board wishes to announce that Genting New York LLC, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of GENM, has been selected for the award of a commercial casino license by the New York State Gaming Commission on 15 December 2025 (US Eastern date/time). Resorts World New York City is expected to open the first phase of the integrated resort by the second quarter of 2026.
GENM will make the necessary announcements should there be further material developments in relation to this matter.
This announcement is dated 16 December 2025.

Working experience and occupation
Dato' Sri Lee Choong Yan was appointed to the Board of the Company on 1 January 2020. He has been the President and Executive Director of the Company since 1 April 2022. Dato' Sri Lee was appointed the President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company on 1 August 2006. He is responsible for the development and implementation of corporate strategies as well as management of the operations of the Company and its subsidiaries.
Dato' Sri Lee is also the Chief Executive Officer of Genting UK Plc, a subsidiary in the United Kingdom, where the Group owns and operates over thirty casinos together with an integrated resort, Resorts World Birmingham. In addition, he oversees Genting Malaysia Group's businesses in the United States and Bahamas. His responsibilities also include directorships in other companies within the Genting Malaysia Berhad Group.
Dato' Sri Lee trained as a chartered accountant in London with an international accounting firm of chartered accountants following which he joined their offices in Hong Kong and worked in their audit and corporate advisory practices. He subsequently embarked on a career in investment banking where he specialised in the areas of corporate finance and the equity capital markets before joining the Genting Group in 1997.

category: General Announcement for PLC
title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM")
- PROPOSED RENEWAL OF THE AUTHORITY FOR GENM TO PURCHASE ITS OWN SHARES
At the Forty-Fifth Annual General Meeting ("
AGM
") of GENM held on 11 June 2025, the shareholders of GENM had approved the renewal of the authority for GENM to purchase its own shares of an amount, which, when aggregated with the treasury shares, does not exceed 10% of its prevailing total number of issued shares at any time ("
Renewed
Share Buy-Back Authority
"). The Renewed Share Buy-Back Authority will expire at the conclusion of GENM's forthcoming AGM.
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that GENM intends to seek the approval of its shareholders for the proposed renewal of the authority for GENM to purchase its own shares of an amount, which, when aggregated with the existing treasury shares, does not exceed 10% of GENM's prevailing total number of issued shares at any time ("
Proposed Share Buy-Back Renewal
") at the forthcoming AGM to be convened.
A statement containing the details of the Proposed Share Buy-Back Renewal will be made available via electronic means to the shareholders of GENM in due course.
This announcement is dated 14 April 2026.

title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD
- PROPOSED RENEWAL OF SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS OF A REVENUE OR TRADING NATURE AND PROPOSED NEW SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR ADDITIONAL RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS OF A REVENUE OR TRADING NATURE
Genting Malaysia Berhad ("the Company") writes to inform that the Company will be seeking the approval of its shareholders for the proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature and proposed new shareholders' mandate for additional recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature ("Proposed Shareholders' Mandate") at a general meeting to be convened.
A Circular to Shareholders containing the details on the Proposed Shareholders' Mandate will be made available via electronic means to the shareholders of the Company in due course.
This announcement is dated 14 April 2026.

title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" or "the Company")
- Voluntary winding up of Genting Alderney Limited, an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary of the Company
Further to GENM's announcement made on 5 June 2025 pertaining to the member's voluntary winding up of Genting Alderney Limited ("GAL"), an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary of the Company incorporated in Alderney, GENM wishes to announce that pursuant to Section 119(3) of the Companies (Alderney) Law, 1994 (as amended), GAL was dissolved on 10 May 2026 (Alderney date) and ceased to be a subsidiary of GENM.
This announcement is dated 11 May 2026.

title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" OR "COMPANY")

PROPOSAL TO ENHANCE THE CAPITAL STRUCTURE AND FINANCIAL POSITION OF EMPIRE RESORTS INC. ("EMPIRE") ("PROPOSAL")
Unless otherwise stated, the exchange rate of USD1.00: RM4.0745, being Bank Negara Malaysia's middle rate as at 5.00 p.m. on 2 July 2026, is used throughout this announcement for purpose of translation of USD into RM.
The Company refers to its announcement dated 15 August 2025 in relation to the Proposal ("Announcement"). The definitions used in this announcement, unless stated otherwise, shall have the same meaning(s) as those used in the Announcement.
Pursuant to Paragraph 9.19 (38) of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, the Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that Empire had on 2
July 2026 (US Eastern date/time) redeemed in full the nominal value of its USD300.0 million (equivalent to approximately RM1.2 billion) 7.75% Senior Secured Notes due 1 November 2026 ("Empire Notes").
With the redemption of the Empire Notes, parties to the Proposal have agreed that the Proposal will not proceed.
This announcement is dated 3 July 2026.

title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
body:
GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD ("GENM" or "the Company")
- Members' voluntary liquidation of GMM Limited, an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary of the Company
The Board of Directors of GENM wishes to announce that the shareholders of GMM Limited ("GMM"), an indirect wholly-owned dormant subsidiary of the Company duly incorporated in Macau, Special Administrative Region have resolved to dissolve GMM pursuant to Article 315(1)(a) of the Commercial Code of Macau on 11 August 2026, following which GMM has commenced its members' voluntary liquidation. The relevant documents had been submitted to the Commerce and Movable Property Registry of Macau on 13 August 2026.
The members' voluntary liquidation of GMM will not have any material impact on the net assets and earnings per share of the GENM group for the financial year ending 31 December 2026.
This announcement is dated 13 August 2026.

Working experience and occupation
Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay was appointed as a Director of the Company on 17 August 1976, was redesignated as the Chairman and Chief Executive of the Company on 1 July 2007. He was the Chairman and Chief Executive of Genting Malaysia Berhad until he was redesignated as the Deputy Chairman and Chief Executive of Genting Malaysia Berhad on 27 August 2020. He was also the Chief Executive and a Director of Genting Plantations Berhad until he relinquished his position as Chief Executive and assumed the position of Deputy Chairman and Executive Director of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 January 2019. He is the Executive Chairman of Genting Singapore Limited and the Chairman of Genting UK Plc. He has served in various positions within the Group since 1976. He is a Founding Member and a Permanent Trustee of The Community Chest, Malaysia. In addition, he sits on the Boards of other Malaysian and foreign companies as well as the Boards of Trustees of several charitable organisations in Malaysia.

Working experience and occupation
Dato' Sri Tan Kong Han, the President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company since 1 July 2007, was appointed as an Executive Director of the Company on 1 January 2020 and redesignated as the President and Chief Operating Officer and Executive Director of the Company on the same day. Dato’ Sri Tan was appointed as the Deputy Chief Executive of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 December 2010 prior to his appointment as Chief Executive and Executive Director of Genting Plantations Berhad on 1 January 2019. He has more than 13 years working experience in investment banking prior to joining Tanjong Public Limited Company as the Group Chief Operating Officer in 2003. He left Tanjong Public Limited Company in 2007 to join the Company.
He serves as a director of a variety of subsidiary companies within the Genting Berhad and Genting Plantations Berhad group. He is also a member of the Board of Trustees of Yayasan Genting and Yayasan Kebajikan Komuniti Malaysia, the Administrator of The Community Chest, Malaysia, a director of Asian Centre for Genomics Technology Berhad and Genting RMTN Berhad, all of which are public companies as well as the Managing Director of Pan Malaysian Pools Sdn Bhd.

Dato' Sri Tan Kong Han holds 1,190,000 ordinary shares in Genting Berhad ("GENT"), 619,400 ordinary shares in Genting Malaysia Berhad ("GENM") and 274,000 ordinary shares in Genting Plantations Berhad.
Dato' Sri Tan has a deemed interest in 100,000 ordinary shares of GENT and 53,500 ordinary shares in GENM by virtue of him being the sole director and shareholder of Chan Fun Chee Holdings Inc ("CFC") which currently holds the assets of his late grandmother's estate. Dato' Sri Tan is the Executor of his late grandmother's estate and holding the CFC assets as trustee for himself and certain of his family members in accordance with the will of his late grandmother.
Remarks :
Dato' Sri Tan Kong Han is appointed as the Chief Executive of the Company with effect from 1 March 2025 and redesignated as the Chief Executive, President and Executive Director of the Company.

category: General Announcement for PLC
title: OTHERS
body:
FILING OF A STIPULATION FOR SETTLEMENT AND ORDER WITH THE NEVADA GAMING CONTROL BOARD FOR CONSIDERATION BEFORE THE NEVADA GAMING COMMISSION
On 16 August 2024, Genting Berhad (“
GENT
” or the “
Company
”) announced that Resorts World Las Vegas LLC (“
RWLV LLC
”), an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of GENT which operates Resorts World Las Vegas in Nevada, the United States of America,  together with RWLV LLC’s  direct and indirect holding companies,  namely RWLV Holdings, LLC, Genting Assets, Inc, Suasana Duta Sdn Bhd, Peak Avenue Limited and GENT (RWLV LLC’s  ultimate holding company) (collectively, the
“Respondents
”) were named in a complaint dated 15 August 2024 filed by the Nevada Gaming Control Board (“
NGCB
”) before the Nevada Gaming Commission seeking disciplinary action against the Respondents.
Further to GENT's announcement on 16 August 2024, the Board of Directors of GENT announces that the Respondents and NGCB have signed the Stipulation for Settlement and Order dated 20 March 2025.
Please refer to the attachment for further details.
This announcement is dated 21 March 2025.
Please refer attachment below.
Attachments
Stipulation for Settlement and Order and Amended Complaint.pdf

NEVADA GAMING COMMISSION APPROVES THE STIPULATION FOR SETTLEMENT AND ORDER FILED BY RESORTS WORLD LAS VEGAS LLC
Further to Genting Berhad’s announcements on 16 August 2024 and 21 March 2025, the Board of Directors of Genting Berhad wishes to announce that the Stipulation for Settlement and Order has been approved by the Nevada Gaming Commission at its hearing on 27 March 2025 (Las Vegas time).
This announcement is dated 28 March 2025.

category: General Announcement for PLC
title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY") 
- PROPOSED RENEWAL OF THE AUTHORITY FOR GENT TO PURCHASE ITS OWN SHARES
At the Fifty-Sixth Annual General Meeting ("AGM") of GENT held on 13 June 2024, the shareholders of GENT had approved the renewal of the authority for GENT to purchase its own shares of an amount, which, when aggregated with the treasury shares, does not exceed 4% of its prevailing total number of issued shares at any time ("Renewed Share Buy-Back Authority"). The Renewed Share Buy-Back Authority will expire at the conclusion of GENT's forthcoming AGM.
The Board of Directors of GENT wishes to announce that GENT intends to seek the approval of its shareholders for the proposed renewal of authority for GENT to purchase its own shares of an amount which, when aggregated with the treasury shares, does not exceed 4% of GENT's prevailing total number of issued shares at any time ("Proposed Share Buy-Back Renewal") at the forthcoming AGM to be convened.
A statement containing the details of the Proposed Share Buy-Back Renewal will be made available via electronic means to the shareholders of GENT in due course.
This announcement is dated 22 April 2025.

body:
GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY") 
- PROPOSED RENEWAL OF SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS OF A REVENUE OR TRADING NATURE
Genting Berhad ("the Company") writes to inform that the Company will be seeking the approval of its shareholders for the proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature ("Proposed Shareholders' Mandate") at a general meeting to be convened.
A Circular to Shareholders containing the details on the Proposed Shareholders' Mandate will be made available via electronic means to the shareholders of the Company in due course.
This announcement is dated 22 April 2025.

body:
GENTING BERHAD, VIA ITS INDIRECT JOINT VENTURE COMPANY, SDIC GENTING MEIZHOU WAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LIMITED, SUCCESSFULLY HANDED OVER ITS 2 X 393MW SUBCRITICAL COAL- FIRED POWER PLANT UNDER THE BUILD, OPERATE, TRANSFER SCHEME IN FUJIAN, CHINA TO THE FUJIAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT UPON THE EXPIRY OF THE 21.5 YEARS POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENT ON 30 JUNE 2025
The Board of Directors of Genting Berhad ("Company") is pleased to announce that the Company's 49% owned indirect joint venture company, SDIC Genting Meizhou Wan Electric Power Company Limited ("SDICG MZW") has successfully handed over its 2 x 393MW subcritical coal-fired Meizhou Wan Power Plant ("MZW Phase I"), to Fujian Investment & Development Group Co., Ltd. ("Shengtou") at 23.59pm on 30 June 2025. MZW Phase I has been operating since 1 January 2004, under a 21.5-year Build-Operate-Transfer ("BOT") power purchase agreement.
Please refer to the attached Press Release for further details.
This announcement is dated 1 July 2025.
Please refer attachment below.

GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY")

CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY GENT TO ACQUIRE ALL THE REMAINING ORDINARY SHARES IN GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES) NOT ALREADY HELD BY GENT FOR A CASH OFFER PRICE OF RM2.35 PER OFFER SHARE ("OFFER")
On behalf of the Board of Directors of GENT, AmInvestment Bank Berhad wishes to announce that it had, on behalf of GENT, served a notice of conditional voluntary take-over offer (“
Notice
”) on the Board of Directors of Genting Malaysia Berhad (“
GENM
”) today to notify them of GENT’s intention to undertake a conditional voluntary take-over offer to acquire all the remaining 2,870,039,874 ordinary shares in GENM (excluding treasury shares) not already held by GENT (“
Offer Shares
”), representing 50.64% equity interest in GENM (excluding treasury shares) for a cash offer price of RM2.35 per Offer Share.
Please refer to the attached announcement and Notice for further details on the Offer.
This announcement is dated 13 October 2025.

GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY")

CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY GENT TO ACQUIRE ALL THE REMAINING ORDINARY SHARES IN GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES) NOT ALREADY HELD BY GENT FOR A CASH OFFER PRICE OF RM2.35 PER OFFER SHARE ("OFFER")
Unless otherwise defined, capitalised terms used in this announcement shall have the same meanings as those given to them in the Offer Document dated 3 November 2025.
On behalf of GENT, AmInvestment Bank Berhad wishes to inform that following the acquisition of GENM Shares from the open market, GENT holds, together with such GENM Shares that are already acquired, held or entitled to be acquired or held, more than 50.00% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares) as at 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 3 November 2025.
Accordingly, the
Acceptance Condition has been fulfilled and the Offer has become unconditional on 3 November 2025 (“Unconditional Date”).
Unless the Offer is extended or revised, the Offer shall remain open for acceptances until 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 24 November 2025, being the First Closing Date, which is at least 14 days from the Unconditional Date.
Please refer to the attached press notice for further information.

Reference is made to the Company’s announcements on 17 September 2019, 8 November 2019 and 25 March 2022 in relation to the MTN Programme.
The Board of Directors of the Company (“
Board
”) wishes to announce that Genting RMTN, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, has today issued RM900 million in nominal value of MTNs under the MTN Programme as follows:
Tranche 5

RM900 million

Affin Hwang Investment Bank Berhad and AmInvestment Bank Berhad are the Joint Lead Managers for this issuance.
This announcement is dated 10 November 2025.

body:
GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY")

UNCONDITIONAL TAKE-OVER OFFER BY GENT TO ACQUIRE ALL THE REMAINING ORDINARY SHARES IN GENTING MALAYSIA BERHAD (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES) NOT ALREADY HELD BY GENT FOR A CASH OFFER PRICE OF RM2.35 PER OFFER SHARE ("OFFER")
Unless otherwise defined, capitalised terms used in this announcement shall have the same meaning as those given to them in the Offer Document dated 3 November 2025.
As at 13 May 2025, being the beginning of the 6-month period prior to and including 13 November 2025 (“
Period
”), GENT and the PACs collectively held a total of 2,802,302,634 GENM Shares, representing 49.44% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares), which is more than 33% but not more than 50% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares).
On behalf of GENT, AmInvestment Bank wishes to announce that GENT has on Thursday, 13 November 2025, acquired a total of 34,929,300 GENM Shares from the open market. Following the above, and excluding Valid Acceptances received, GENT and the PACs have collectively acquired a total of 114,469,300 GENM Shares during the Period, representing 2.02% of the total issued GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares), at prices not exceeding the Offer Price of RM2.35 per Offer Share.
As GENT and the PACs have acquired (other than through Valid Acceptances received) more than 2% of GENM Shares during the Period, GENT is required under paragraph 4.01(b) of the Rules to extend a mandatory take-over offer (“
MO
”) to acquire all the remaining GENM Shares (excluding treasury shares) not already held by GENT.
In view of the above, the
present unconditional voluntary take-over offer has become an unconditional MO
on 13 November 2025 in accordance with note 14 of paragraph 4.01 of the Rules.
GENT and the PACs have not purchased nor agreed to purchase any GENM Shares at a price (excluding stamp duty and commission) higher than the Offer Price in the 6 months prior to the commencement of the Offer Period and during the Offer Period, up to and including 13 November 2025. As such, there is no requirement for GENT to revise the Offer Price upwards in accordance with subparagraph 6.03(1) of the Rules.
For the avoidance of doubt, the Offer will continue to be undertaken solely by GENT and is extended to the PACs.
Further to the above, on behalf of GENT, AmInvestment Bank wishes to announce that the closing time and date for the acceptance of the Offer has been
extended
from 5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 24 November 2025 to
5:00 p.m. (Malaysian time) on Monday, 1 December 2025
(“
Extended Closing Date
”).
Other than the Offer becoming an unconditional MO and the Extended Closing Date, all other terms and conditions of the Offer as set out in the Offer Document remain unchanged.
A notification will be dispatched to the shareholders of GENM in due course to notify, amongst others, the details of the matters above.
Please refer to the attached press notice for further information.
This announcement is dated 13 November 2025.
Please refer attachment below.

body:
GENTING BERHAD ("GENT")

(I)	ISSUANCE OF MEDIUM TERM NOTES ("MTN") BY GENTING VISTA BERHAD ("GENTING VISTA") PURSUANT TO THE RM5.0 BILLION UNRATED MTN PROGRAMME GUARANTEED BY GENT ("UNRATED MTN PROGRAMME") 

(II)	REDEMPTION OF MTN BY GENTING RMTN BERHAD ("GENTING RMTN") PURSUANT TO THE RM10.0 BILLION MTN PROGRAMME GUARANTEED BY GENT ("MTN PROGRAMME")
Reference is made to GENT’s announcements on:
(a) 5 December 2025 in relation to the Unrated MTN Programme; and
(b) 17 September 2019, 8 November 2019, 25 March 2022, 10 November 2025, 20 November 2025, 27 November 2025 and 5 December 2025 in relation to the MTN Programme.
Further to the above, the Board of Directors of GENT wishes to announce that Genting Vista, a wholly owned subsidiary of GENT, has today issued RM3.0 billion in nominal value of MTN (“
Series 1 MTN
”) under the Unrated MTN Programme as follows:
Series 1 MTN
Issue size
RM3.0 billion
Issue price
Issued at par
Tenure of issue
1 to 5 years
Interest rate (p.a.)
3-month KLIBOR + 1.80%
The proceeds raised from the Series 1 MTN issuance above shall be utilised to redeem the MTN issued by Genting RMTN, a wholly owned subsidiary of GENT, which were utilised to part finance the acquisition of ordinary shares in Genting Malaysia Berhad pursuant to the takeover offer by GENT.
Affin Hwang Investment Bank Berhad and AmInvestment Bank Berhad are the Lead Managers for the Series 1 MTN issuance.
Pursuant to Paragraph 9.19 (38) of the Main Market Listing Requirements of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, the Board of Directors of GENT wishes to further announce that Genting RMTN has today fully redeemed the aggregate RM3.0 billion nominal value of MTN issued on 10 November 2025, 20 November 2025, 27 November 2025 and 5 December 2025 under the MTN Programme.
This announcement is dated 30 December 2025.

GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR "COMPANY")

OFFERING BY GOHL CAPITAL HOLDINGS LIMITED OF US$750,000,000 7.625% SUBORDINATED PERPETUAL CAPITAL SECURITIES (NC5.5) ("SERIES 1 SECURITIES") AND US$500,000,000 8.300% SUBORDINATED PERPETUAL CAPITAL SECURITIES (NC10) ("SERIES 2 SECURITIES")
1. INTRODUCTION
The Company wishes to announce that its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, GOHL Capital Holdings Limited ("
GCH
" or the "
Issuer
"), has on 22 April 2026 completed the book-building process and priced its offering of the Series 1 Securities and Series 2 Securities (collectively, the "
Securities
") (the "
Offering
"). The Securities have been offered and sold outside the United States of America in reliance on Regulation S under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended. The Securities will be guaranteed on a subordinated basis by Genting Overseas Holdings Limited ("
GOHL
" or the "
Guarantor
"), a direct wholly owned subsidiary of GENT. The Guarantor holds 100% equity interest in the Issuer. The Securities will also have the benefit of a subordinated keepwell deed to be entered into with GENT.
Moody's Investors Service, Inc. has assigned a rating of Ba2 to the Securities, whilst Fitch Ratings, Ltd has assigned a rating of BB+ to the Securities.
Deutsche Bank AG, Singapore Branch and J.P. Morgan Securities Asia Pte. Ltd., are the  Joint Global Coordinators for the Offering, and Barclays Bank PLC, Citigroup Global Markets Singapore Pte. Ltd., Deutsche Bank AG, Singapore Branch and J.P. Morgan Securities Asia Pte. Ltd., are the Joint Bookrunners for the Offering. DBS Bank Ltd is the Co-Manager for the Offering.
The Securities are expected to be listed on The Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited ("
SGX-ST
") on or around 30 April 2026.
2. PRINCIPAL TERMS OF THE SECURITIES
A summary of the principal terms and conditions of the Securities is as follows:
Issuer
GCH
Guarantor
GOHL
Keepwell provider
GENT (the "
Parent
")
Status
Subordinated perpetual capital securities, subordinated to senior unsecured obligations of the Issuer, the Guarantor and the Parent

Perpetual Non-Call 10
First Reset Date
Year 5.5 (29 October 2031)

Year 10 (29 April 2036)
Distribution
Fixed rate payable semi-annually in arrears until the First Reset Date
Distribution Reset
Distribution rate resets in year 5.5, and every 5 years thereafter
Distribution rate resets in year 10, and every 5 years thereafter
Distribution Step-up
25 bps step in year 10.5 and additional 75 bps step in year 25.5
25 bps step in year 10 and additional 75 bps step in year 30
Distribution Deferral
The Issuer may defer distributions at its sole discretion
Deferred distributions will be cumulative and there is no limit to number of deferrals
The Issuer must defer distributions during certain events as set out in the conditions of the Securities
Dividend Stoppers
No dividend stopper from the Issuer/Guarantor to the Parent
Dividend stopper only at the Parent level
In the event distributions are deferred, the Parent will not be permitted to declare or pay any discretionary dividends or distributions (other than equity-only payments or exchanges), until deferred distributions are satisfied
Listing
SGX-ST
Governing law
English Law except certain provisions (insofar as they relate to a winding-up of the Issuer, the Guarantor and Parent) will be governed by Isle of Man law or Malaysian law, as applicable
3. USE OF PROCEEDS
The Issuer intends to use the net proceeds for repayment of outstanding GOHL Capital Limited's US$1.5 billion notes due in January 2027 plus accrued interest thereon and for other refinancing needs of GENT and its subsidiaries. GOHL Capital Limited is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of GENT.
Please refer to GENT's announcements in relation to the tender offer dated 20 April 2026 and 23 April 2026 for further details.
4. APPROVALS REQUIRED
The Offering is not subject to any regulatory or shareholder approvals.
This announcement is dated 23 April 2026.
This announcement does not constitute or form part of any offer to purchase, a solicitation of an offer to purchase, an offer to sell or an invitation or solicitation of an offer to sell, issue or subscribe for,  securities in or into the United States or in any other jurisdiction. No securities mentioned herein have been, or will be, registered under the United States Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"), or any state securities laws or other jurisdiction of the United States and no such securities may be offered or sold in or into the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from, or in a transaction not subject to, the registration requirements under the Securities Act and any applicable state or local securities laws of the United States. There is no intention to register any securities referred to herein in the United States or to make a public offering of the securities in the United States or in any other jurisdiction where such an offering is restricted or prohibited or where such offer would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of such jurisdiction. Nothing in this announcement shall constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer or sale would be unlawful. Any offering of securities will be made by means of one or more offering documents, which will contain detailed information about the Issuer, the Guarantor or GENT their management and financial statements. No action has been taken in any jurisdiction that would permit a public offering of the securities to occur in any jurisdiction.  Neither this announcement nor any portion hereof may be sent or transmitted, directly or indirectly, in or into the United States or any jurisdiction where it is unlawful to do so. Failure to comply with the above restrictions may result in a violation of the Securities Act or the applicable laws of other jurisdictions. title: OTHERS
body:
GENTING BERHAD ("GENT" OR THE "COMPANY")
RENAMING OF THE RISK MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE TO RISK MANAGEMENT AND SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTEE
The Board of Directors of the Company wishes to announce that the Risk Management Committee of the Company has been renamed as the Risk Management and Sustainability Committee with effect from 1 September 2026, to include oversight on sustainability matters.
The composition of the Risk Management and Sustainability Committee of the Company remains the same as the Risk Management Committee except for the relinquishment of the position of Chairman by Mr Lee Tuck Heng and the appointment of Madam Koid Swee Lian as the Chairperson in place thereof with immediate effect, as set out below:
(1) Madam Koid Swee Lian - Chairperson/Independent Non-Executive Director
(2) Mr Lee Tuck Heng - Member/Independent Non-Executive Director
(3) Datuk Manharlal A/L Ratilal - Member/Independent Non-Executive Director
This announcement is dated 1 September 2026.
